name: How to Organize PDF Pages
description: Reorder, delete, and rotate PDF pages by dragging thumbnails — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Drag to reorder, delete, or rotate
step.text: Drag page thumbnails to arrange them in a new order, click × to delete unwanted pages, and select pages to rotate 90°, 180°, or 270°.

step.name: Download the organized PDF
step.text: Click 'Save'. Your reordered, trimmed, and rotated PDF is ready to download instantly.
